text:
Liam Ross: Heads up 11 Meterlyx renewal (INV-MX-031) landed in our inbox and the SKU mix is wrong. They converted us to an Enterprise seat bundle in the pdf but we were on pure API consumption.

Talia Rivera: Can you attach the invoice? I can pull our usage to compare.

Liam Ross: Uploaded: https://files.redwood/procurement/meterlyx_invoice_mar.pdf 1 summary from the PDF: Enterprise bundle $95k/yr (50 seats + 1M included calls/yr), onboarding $10k, overage $0.004/call.

Olivia Chen: Our usage last 3 months: Dec 2025 600k, Jan 2026 680k, Feb 2026 720k. That's ~7.2M/yr. 1M included is way off. We were explicitly on consumption for the pilot.

Ben (Meterlyx Sales): Hi team 1 sorry for the confusion, looks like the renewal tool auto-selected Enterprise based on an internal mapping. We can switch to a committed consumption offer. Two options: (1) 6M calls/yr at $0.0042/call + $2k seats/admin = $26,200/yr, onboarding waived; (2) 8M calls/yr at $0.0035/call + $3k seats = $31,000/yr, onboarding waived. Both include monthly usage reports and a 30-day pilot return policy.

Talia Rivera: Option 2 math: 8M * 0.0035 = 28k + 3k seats = 31k. That's a big delta vs their $95k list. Good. Need these in writing + contract language for ramp / renegotiation.

Liam Ross: Procurement asks: 1) Confirm committed unit price locked for 12 months, 2) Explicit monthly dollar cap on overages (we prefer $2,500/mo), 3) 60-day pilot termination with full refund, 4) Update invoice layout to show "Committed Consumption" math for AP, 5) Net30 payment terms, 6) DPA + SOC2.

Ben (Meterlyx Sales): We can commit to a 12-month price lock for the chosen tier. For overage cap 1 we can do $2,500/mo cap for option 2. Pilot termination 45 days is standard, but I can escalate 60 days. Invoice reformatting and DPA is fine.

Olivia Chen: Legal question: any indemnity or IP clauses we should flag? Ben, ensure the DPA covers customer data retention and deletion on termination.

Ben (Meterlyx Sales): Will include DPA & standard indemnity. I will mark deletion window as 30 days post-termination and add SOC2 in schedule.

Talia Rivera: Also request a clause that if monthly avg exceeds committed by >125% for 3 months we re-open the price conversation; otherwise the rate is stable.

Ben (Meterlyx Sales): Agreed, I'll add a 125% trigger to renegotiate after 3 consecutive months.

FinanceOpsBot: FYI: Commits > $25k/yr need FinanceOps approval and a PO. See https://intra.redwood/finance/commit-policy. Route when counter is finalized.

Liam Ross: Great. Ben, can you post a redlined counter and the corrected invoice (PDF) here so AP/legal can review? We'll push for option 2 (8M) pending Finance sign-off.

Ben (Meterlyx Sales): Will do. Draft redline + corrected invoice posted: https://docs.redwood/contracts/meterlyx-counter-031.md — will follow up with an editable PDF in a bit.

Olivia Chen: +1 on option 2, endorsing the $2.5k monthly cap and 60-day pilot. Once redline is in Legal/Procurement will escalate to FinanceOps. :thumbsup:
